We can't wait to share that Amazon's fall Prime Day deals are kicking off early today — AirPods Pro 3 are now down to $179 with free shipping, one of the lowest prices we've seen to date.

Although the official start of the fall Prime Big Deal Days is still about 48 hours away, Amazon has jumped the gun, currently selling Apple's flagship AirPods Pro 3 at $179 with free shipping.

  • AirPods Pro 3 for $179 (regularly $249) — one of the best deals ever

The current-generation Pro is priced at $249. While we saw it dip to $199 a few times this summer, this time it's been marked down even further — a steep $70 off, making the discount extremely attractive.

Apple recently officially launched two versions of the all-new AirPods 5: the base model with ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) at $129, and an upgraded version that includes a wireless charging case. Apple's newly released base model with ANC is priced at $129, which I personally think is a pretty good value, but if you want the model with the wireless charging case, it's $149; right now, for just $30 more, you can get the much more capable AirPods Pro 3.

The Pro 3 offers 3x stronger Active Noise Cancellation, longer battery life, and more advanced health features such as a built-in heart rate sensor and hearing aid functionality. For more details, be sure to check out our recent comparison feature — AirPods Pro 3 vs. AirPods 5.

The base-model AirPods 5 at $129 is certainly a solid choice, but the more capable AirPods Pro 3 at $179 represents an extremely attractive discount, and aside from today, we've only seen that same low price once before.

This price drop comes mere weeks after Apple rolled out several new features for the AirPods Pro 3 alongside iOS 27. The update includes the long-awaited custom EQ feature:

Other new features include new ways to control Adaptive Audio, improved Find My integration, and more.
